title: SMB bolus shows as a Meal bolus in record and on the display graph.
symptom: When APS generates a SMB it shows correctly on the graph then changes to a meal bolus.
cause: The issue was likely caused by the Dexcom app uploading results to Nightscout, conflicting with NSClient synchronization.
fix: The user disabled the Dexcom app's upload to Nightscout and enabled Share in the Dexcom app, which they believe solved the issue.
settings_changed: Dexcom app upload to NS → disabled
evidence_quote: I noticed that in the Dexcom app it was uploading results to NS. I disabled this as I had it syncing in NSclient /syncronization/upload data to NS. In also did not have share on in Dexcom app which is now enabled.
